- Southwest Airlines: Operating income of $321M on total operating revenue of $27,483M [DOC-1], yielding an operating margin of approximately 1.17% ($321M ÷ $27,483M).

- Southwest Airlines: Total stockholders' equity at Dec 31, 2024 was **$10,350M** (positive), and long-term debt stood at **$6,697M** [DOC-1].

No. American Airlines leads on operating margin (profitability from operations relative to revenue), while Southwest Airlines leads decisively on balance-sheet strength (positive equity and much lower leverage).
